Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is hiring an Early Career Digital Embedded Software Engineer. The role focuses on embedded real-time software development, digital signal processing, algorithm analysis, and verification and testing of DSP software and equipment.
Early-career digital embedded software engineer developing real-time C/C++ software and modeling, analyzing, and verifying DSP algorithms

Requirements:
• experience and/or knowledge of one or more areas, including:
• Embedded C/C++ Real-Time Software Development
• MATLAB – Algorithm Design/Modeling, Algorithm/System Performance Analysis, Root Cause Data Analysis, Test Vector Generation
• EI&T / I&T – Verification of DSP Software, Site/Shipboard System Level Test of DSP Equipment
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• BS Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent
• Experience in digital signal processing theory, FPGA design with C/C++ programming, and/or simulation tools such as MATLAB or ModelSim
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access
